text:
jess: trying the Python quickstart; first /v1/generate returns 403 billing_required after following README steps. anyone seen this?

tony: can you paste the minimal snippet you ran?

jess: sure:
```
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=sk_test_abc
python quickstart.py
# HTTP/1.1 403
# {"error":"billing_required", "message":"Workspace needs payment method"}
```

cli-bot: heads-up: quickstart.py currently reads REDWOOD_API_KEY, while the README mentions REDWOOD_TOKEN.

jess: hmm that mismatch would normally surface as auth errors (401) but I'm seeing billing_required, so feels like two separate DX problems: env var/parity + onboarding billing gating.

tony: invited users sometimes land in an org that hasn't set up billing. API returns 403 until the workspace has a payment method or the owner enables a trial. Quick unblock: create a personal workspace in console or run `redwood-cli workspaces create --name jess-personal` then link.

jess: created a personal workspace in the console and retried; now 200 OK and the quickstart prints output. :tada:

devex-bot: Tickets filed: DX-3490 (quickstart env var parity) and DX-3491 (SDK: improve billing_required UX with link to workspace billing).

jess: leaving a short repro note on the quickstart PR and adding a sentence about billing gating for invited users. thanks!

tony: thanks for the repro, will prioritize DX-3490 in the next docs sprint.
